pick.headline: Martial law declared in Isfahan
pick.fbis: The Middle East & North Africa Daily Report of August 14, 1978, carried an AFP report of a curfew in Esfahan after rioters ransacked the Shah Abbas Hotel, and Tehran radio's government statement declaring a month of martial law in the city.
